description.zh-CN: 图形化创建新 Brick 工程的向导：选择运行时、UI 栈与依赖工具，基于 create-brickly 内核生成工程骨架并写入开发目录。
description.en: Wizard that scaffolds new Brick projects: pick runtime, UI stack and dependency bricks, generate the project skeleton via the create-brickly core into the dev catalog.

description.zh-CN: 返回 create-brickly 的运行时、UI 栈、功能预设枚举与默认值。
description.en: Return create-brickly runtime / UI stack / feature preset enums and defaults.

description.zh-CN: 列出开发目录与已安装工具的轻量条目，用于依赖选择器。
description.en: List lightweight entries of development and installed bricks for the dependency picker.

description.zh-CN: 按完整 BrickRef 查询工具的 manifest 作者字段子集（命令、配置字段等）。
description.en: Fetch the manifest author-field subset of a brick by full BrickRef.

description.zh-CN: 按向导草稿生成文件清单、manifest 与告警，不落盘。
description.en: Generate file list, manifest and warnings from the wizard draft without writing to disk.

description.zh-CN: 将草稿生成物写入开发目录，校验依赖引用后触发目录重扫。
description.en: Write the draft's generated files into the dev catalog, verify dependency refs, then rescan.
